title: Streckfus riverboat job and Rappolo joining the band
summary: The band takes the boat job, Rappolo replaces the clarinetist at Davenport, and Bix sits in.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: I know who your name is.

Oh, he's from New Orleans. Well, it was Paul Morais, myself, and, uh, Jack Pettis, and the rest of the boys were from, uh, St. Louis. So we went down there, we got the job on the boat, and we lived on the boat, and, uh, Tony Palazano. Yeah, something like that.

Well, he's now with the syndicate, I think, uh, dealer or something. So we got down there a while, and then we hit Davenport, and Rap was going with a young lady down there, and he come in and sat on the boat one night. They let Palazolo go, and, uh, Tony Palazolo, I think that's his name. So, uh, Rap joined the band, and then we, that's where I met Black, the banjo player, and, uh, Bix used to come out and, uh, sit in. It was from Davenport, and, well, he was a great trumpet player.
